overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Soria 3 Person Hybrid Sauna Indoor Full Spectrum Harvia Stove offers a luxurious and rejuvenating sauna experience right in your home. Designed for wellness, it combines a Harvia 6KW traditional stove with full spectrum infrared technology, featuring 8 IR emitters and 5 Carbon PureTech™ Near Zero EMF heating panels, to promote muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation. Constructed from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, this sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, and includes modern amenities like Bluetooth connectivity and chromotherapy lighting for a truly immersive experience. With its versatile design, it can even transform into a yoga studio, making it a valuable addition to any wellness routine.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Golden Designs is proud to offer the Soria Indoor Hybrid Sauna featuring our PureTech Full Spectrum Infrared Technology and Harvia Traditional Stove heating options (IR and Stove do not operate at the same time). When the benches are removed, the sauna becomes a yoga/stretching studio. Constructed with the environment in mind, our saunas are made with reforested Canadian Hemlock planks that surpass industry standards, thus producing a quality sauna that retains heat more efficiently, heats up faster and uses less energy in the process.
